en-US.p:
We are pleased to announce the launch of new market named "Max Keno 2" for Keno product with effect from {effectdate}.
- Bet settings and offer statuses will be copied from Max Keno market.
- The Position Taking settings will follow the Australia market settings.
All settings will be available for configuration in Edit Keno feature, located at Account Info on 11/9/2016.
Massachusetts and Malta markets will be removed on {effectdate}.

所有设置将可用于快乐彩功能中的配置, 位于用户资料于 11/9/2016。
马萨诸塞和马耳他市场将删除于{effectdate}。

th-TH.p: เรียน เอเจนต์

ทางบริษัทใคร่ขอประกาศให้ทราบว่าทางเราจะเปิดตลาดใหม่ชื่อว่า "Max Keno 2" ซึ่งเกม Keno นี้จะใช้งานได้ตั้งแต่วันที่ {effectdate}.
- การตั้งค่าการแทง และสถานะต่าง ๆ จะคัดลอกจาก Max Keno
- การตั้งค่าเอี่ยวจะตั้งค่าตาม การตั้งค่าของ Keno ออสเตรเลีย
ทุกการตั้งค่าจะสามารถทำได้ในส่วนของ Keno ซึ่งอยู่ที่ รายละเอียดบัญชีในวันที่ 11/9/2016.
ตลาด แมสซาชูเซตส์ และ มอลตา Keno จะถูกถอดออกในวันที่ {effectdate}.

vi-VN.p:
Chúng tôi trân trọng giới thiệu thị trường mới mang tên "Max Keno 2" dành cho sản phẩm Keno sẽ được ra mắt vào ngày {effectdate}.
- Giới hạn cược và Trạng thái của thị trường này sẽ được sao chép từ thị trường Max Keno.
- Position Taking sẽ theo thiết lập của thị trường Australia.
Từ ngày 11/9/2016, tất cả thiết lập sẽ sẵn sàng cho việc cấu hình bằng tính năng Edit Keno trong thiết lập của Account Info.
Thị trường Massachusetts và Malta sẽ được xoá khỏi hệ thống vào ngày {effectdate}.

PopupAnnouncement.name: OTP

en-US.p: Your privacy and security are our highest priority. The One-Time Password (OTP) feature will be released on mm/dd/yyyy to provide enhanced security to our system. Once enabled, the OTP will replace your Security Code.

PopupAnnouncement.zh-CN:
尊敬的代理们，
您的隐私和安全是我们的最高优先。 为了增强我们系统的安全性，一次性密码（OTP）功能将发布于mm / dd / yyyy，一旦启用，OTP将代替您的保安码。
谢谢
PopupAnnouncement.zh-TW:
尊敬的代理們，
您的隱私和安全是我們的最高優先。為了增強我們系統的安全性，一次性密碼（OTP）功能將發佈於mm / dd / yyyy，一旦啟用，OTP將代替您的保安碼。
謝謝

Your privacy and security are our highest priority. The One-Time Password (OTP) feature will be released on mm/dd/yyyy to provide enhanced security to our system. Once enabled, the OTP will replace your Security Code.

เรียน เอเจนต์
ข้อมูลส่วนตัว และความปลอดภัยของท่าน เป็นมีความสำคัญเป็นอย่างสูงสำหรับเรา ระบบ ใส่พาสเวิร์ดครั้งเดียว (OTP) จะถูกนำไปใช้ในวันที่ mm/dd/yyyy เพื่อเป็นการเพิ่มความปลอดภัยในกับระบบของเรา เมื่อมีการเปิดใช้งาน OTP ก็จะเป็นตัวที่ใช้แทน รหัสความปลอดภัยของท่าน
ขอบพระคุณ
PopupAnnouncement.vi-VN:
Kính gửi quý khách hàng,
Sự an toàn và bảo mật của quý vị là ưu tiên hàng đầu của chúng tôi. Nhằm tăng tính bảo mật cho hệ thống, kể từ ngày dd/mm/yyyy, tính năng One-Time Password (OTP) sẽ được đưa vào hoạt động. Khi được kích hoạt, tính năng OTP sẽ thay thế cho Security Code.
Trân trọng

PopupAnnouncement.name: Alpha_Security_Enhancement
PopupAnnouncement.en-US:
Dear valued agents,
Your security and privacy are extremely important to us. Therefore, we continuously strive to improve our security precautions to protect your data. For this reason, you're required to enter your security code when performing sensitive actions such as:
- Editing sub account permissions.
- Creating a new sub account/downline.
- Resetting/changing password and security code.
- Updating product settings.
- Transferring and updating credit.
Thank you
PopupAnnouncement.zh-CN:
尊敬的代理们，
您的隐私与安全保障非常重要。因此，我们将不断改善安全系统以维护您的资料。所以，当您采取以下动作时需输入保安码：
- 修改子账号权限
- 新增子账号/下线
- 重设/修改密码与保安码
- 更新产品设定
- 转账与更新余额
谢谢

- 修改子賬號權限
- 新增子賬號/下線

- 更新產品設定
- 轉賬與更新餘額

PopupAnnouncement.en-US:
Dear valued agents,
We are pleased to announce the launching of 14 new bet types of Soccer with effect from {effectdate} including:
- Exact 2nd Half Goals
- Both Teams To Score/Result
- Both Teams To Score/Total Goal
- Which Half First Goal
- Home Team Which Half First Goal
- Away Team Which Half First Goal
- First Team 2 Goals
- First Team 3 Goals
- First Goal Method
- To Win From Behind
- 1H Winning Margin
- Both Team To Score in 1H/ 2H
- Home 1H To Score/2H To Score
- Away 1H To Score/2H To Score
These bet types are also available for Parlay and all settings are configured as follows:
- For Exact 2nd Half Goals, the Position Taking will follow Soccer Total Goal’s settings and Commission will follow Others bet type’s settings. - For remaining bet types, the Position Taking and Commission will follow Soccer Others bet type's settings.
Thank you

การตั้งค่าทั้งหมดจะเปิดให้ดำเนินการได้ตั้งแต่วันที่ {effectdate} เป็นต้นไป
ขอบคุณ

- Các thiết lập về hoa hồng sẽ được sao chép từ Live Casino.
- Giới hạn cược của member sẽ không vượt quá Giới hạn cược cung cấp bởi SMA.
- Giới hạn thắng cược của member sẽ được sao chép từ Live Casino.
Nếu không có thiết lập nào được sao chép từ Live Casino, bạn phải cấu hình các thiết lập cho AllBet trước khi sản phẩm này được cho phép đặt cược.
Tất cả các thiết lập sẽ sẵn sàng cho việc cấu hình kể từ ngày {effectdate}.
